name: ac-service-hub
description: Highcool Service Hub — AC Service Management System

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.prototype:build: cd prototype && npm install && npm run build
